301 Moved Permanently 表示资源已永久移动到新地址，浏览器和: 301 Moved Permanently means the resource has moved to a new address permanently, and browsers and search engines will update bookmarks and indexes; 302 Found means a temporary jump and the original address is still in use. Both redirect automatically, but 301 passes SEO weight more explicitly. If you need to keep the original request method (e.g. POST stays POST), use 307 (temporary) or 308 (permanent).
401 和 403 有什么不同？: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
401 Unauthorized 表示请求缺少有效的身份验证凭证，服务器要求先登: 401 Unauthorized means the request lacks valid authentication credentials and the server requires you to log in first or send a token; 403 Forbidden means you are authenticated but the current account has no permission to access the resource. In short: 401 asks who you are, while 403 says you do not have permission.
5xx 表示服务器侧出错。常见如 500（代码异常，查服务端日志）、502/50: 5xx indicates a server-side error. Common cases: 500 (code exception, check the server logs), 502/504 (no response from or timeout on the gateway/proxy upstream; check whether the backend is alive or overloaded), 503 (service temporarily unavailable, often during maintenance or rate limiting; retry later per the Retry-After header). Most 5xx errors require server-side troubleshooting; clients can retry first to confirm whether it is intermittent.

All matching in this tool uses local regular expressions and no information is uploaded.
如何判断访问者是不是爬虫或机器人？: How can I tell whether a visitor is a crawler or bot?
工具会检测 UA 中是否含 Googlebot、Baiduspider、Bing: The tool checks whether the UA contains typical crawler identifiers such as Googlebot, Baiduspider, Bingbot, Yandex, Bytespider or Shenma, or the generic keywords Spider/Crawler/Bot. If matched, it is flagged as a crawler bot, which helps with statistics or anti-bot analysis.
为什么同一台电脑不同浏览器内核写法不同？: Why do different browsers on the same computer write the engine differently?
现代浏览器多基于 Chromium（Blink 引擎），但 UA 中会保留历史兼: Modern browsers are mostly based on Chromium (the Blink engine), but the UA retains legacy compatibility fields (such as the Safari version and AppleWebKit identifier). The tool synthesizes these fields and prefers the real product name (such as Edge or Chrome) over the engine name, giving a product judgment closer to reality.
